item.title: Why I Built My First Browser Game in 2016
item.dc:creator: Elias
item.description: The story of the first playable thing I ever shipped.
item.content:encoded:
It started as an afternoon experiment: a <canvas> element, a while loop, and a ball that should bounce off the walls. Two days later it had a score, a game-over screen, and a single very confused friend.

About me — more on that later. The important part: the browser made the distribution problem disappear. A URL is a store.

item.title: Pixel Art Basics: A Tiny Reference
item.dc:creator: Elias
item.description: Palette, dithering, and the rules I actually follow.
item.content:encoded:
Three rules kept me sane: limit the palette, dither by pairs, not randomness, and outline only where the eye gets lost. Everything else is taste.

Here is the 8×8 grid I kept taped above my desk for three years.
